issues.where: Frames 1721–1829, eastern Pacific cloud spiral and upper-right aurora
issues.what: The globe drifts subtly, but the cloud spiral and auroral ridges keep nearly the same shapes relative to it, making the hold feel more like a moving still than a living planet.
issues.fix: Give the cloud layer slow independent advection and gently vary the auroral ridges over time without moving the stars.

issues.where: Frames 1920–1985, foreground cloud banks and the turquoise shallows on the right
issues.what: The first part of the terrain glide has weak depth separation: foreground clouds and coastline barely shift against the distant horizon until later in the move.
issues.fix: Carry a little more lateral camera velocity into the early glide and keep foreground cloud layers at distinct heights so their parallax develops sooner.
